Gate identities

Source: R/physics-quantum-circuitutils.R
identitysearch.Rd

Tools of sympy.physics.quantum.identitysearch. is_scalar_nonsparse_matrix() (also is_scalar_matrix()) tests whether a circuit is a scalar multiple of the identity, generate_gate_rules() and generate_equivalent_ids() give the equivalent forms of a gate identity, GateIdentity(...) holds an identity and bfs_identity_search() and random_identity_search() look for them. The scipy sparse version is_scalar_sparse_matrix() uses the same exact computation here.

Usage

is_scalar_nonsparse_matrix(circuit, nqubits, identity_only, eps = NULL)

is_scalar_sparse_matrix(circuit, nqubits, identity_only, eps = 1e-11)

is_scalar_matrix(circuit, nqubits, identity_only, eps = NULL)

generate_gate_rules(gate_seq, return_as_muls = FALSE)

generate_equivalent_ids(gate_seq, return_as_muls = FALSE)

GateIdentity(...)

is_degenerate(identity_set, gate_identity)

is_reducible(circuit, nqubits, begin, end)

bfs_identity_search(
  gate_list,
  nqubits,
  max_depth = NULL,
  identity_only = FALSE
)

random_identity_search(gate_list, numgates, nqubits)

Arguments

circuit, gate_seq

A circuit (a product or list of gates).

nqubits

The number of qubits.

identity_only

Accept only the identity, not its multiples.

eps

Unused tolerance of the sparse version.

return_as_muls

Return products instead of lists.

...

Gates.

identity_set

A list of GateIdentity objects.

gate_identity

A list of gates.

begin, end

The range of gates (0-based, end excluded).

gate_list

A list of gates.

max_depth

The maximum circuit length.

numgates

The number of gates.

Value

A logical, a list (a set) or a GateIdentity.

Examples

x <- XGate(0)
is_scalar_nonsparse_matrix(list(x, x), 1, TRUE)
#> [1] TRUE
generate_equivalent_ids(list(x, YGate(0), ZGate(0)))
